name: mindhive
description: MindHive. /circle drives the headless Claude Code CLI iteration-by-iteration until a task is done — memory-seeded each round and bounded by token/cost budgets, a context smart-zone reset, a dual-condition exit gate, and a circuit breaker. /mindhive orchestrates an idea end-to-end with ULT-IDEA rigor on a memory spine: a recall-before-ask preflight, a five-gap idea pressure test, agent-native architecture review, a scored skill Recommendation Matrix anchored on measured telemetry, execution with follow-up chaining, and learnings logged back to the ledger — usable across Claude Code, Cowork, and NewTask. /mindhive-orchestrator is the single centralized pipeline: a ten-stage sequential, dynamic workflow (brainstorm → plan → observation → understand → PRD → matrix → kanban → execution → quality → learning) whose main execution engine is the superpowers and compound-engineering plugins, advancing automatically when intent is clear and converging with the user when it is not, and fanning execution out to parallel sub-agents over a file-complexity cluster database (hive clusters). /engineering-loop fuses /circle with the lfg pipeline into a plan→work→review→fix→verify→learn loop; any installed skill is callable through MindHive (green/red status) with failures feeding an improvement loop.
